# [TASK] Gateway TMDB facade routing + auth/account proxy to real TMDB

## Task
Route the TMDB v3 surface at the gateway and transparently proxy TMDB's auth/account endpoints to the real API, so the browser never holds a TMDB key.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `/genre/**`, `/movie/**`, `/discover/**` -> movie-service; `/person/**`, `/search/person` -> actor-service; `/search/movie` -> movie-service (split, not a blanket `/search/**`, to avoid route-order collisions) — `application.yml`
- [x] `/authentication/**` and `/account/**` proxy to `api.themoviedb.org/3`: client `api_key` stripped, server-side key injected, upstream status and body relayed verbatim
- [x] `curl :8080/movie/popular` returns a TMDB-shaped page — verified live
      (`MovieServiceContractTest`, and the `/movie/**` route predicate in
      `backend/api-gateway/src/main/resources/application.yml`)
- [x] Real login flow (token -> approval -> session -> account) and favorites/watchlist GET+POST verified live end-to-end against the real TMDB account
- [x] `GatewayIntegrationTest` (20 tests, full gateway + Spring Security + Resilience4j + Redis rate limiting) green; repeatable via `infrastructure/docker/smoke-test.sh` (71 requests, 76 assertions, 0 failures)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 12

## Notes
CORS for the React dev origin and preserving the existing `/api/v1` routes were also part of this task and are covered by the same test suite.
